properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued September 29 at 11:47AM EDT until September 29 at 12:30PM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
SMWTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Bonita Beach to Englewood FL out 20 NM...
Waters from Bonita Beach to Englewood FL out 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1230 PM EDT.

* At 1147 AM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located 27 nm west of North Captiva Island, moving
east at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats, damage
vessels, and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots,
suddenly higher waves, frequent lightning, and heavy
downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

* The severe thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.
properties.area: Coastal waters from Bonita Beach to Englewood FL out 20 NM; Waters from Bonita Beach to Englewood FL out 20 to 60 NM

the next 24 to 48 hours.

* Until 1015 AM MDT.

* At 716 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 0.5 and 1 inch of rain
has fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible
in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lake Valley.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain.
Arroyos, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.

rainfall.

Arizona...

Bend Wash. Low-water crossings may inundated with water and may not
be passable.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 29 at 5:24AM MDT until September 30 at 12:00AM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Albuquerque has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in New Mexico...

Pecos River Above Pecos affecting San Miguel County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Pecos River above Pecos.

* WHEN...From this morning to late tonight.

* IMPACTS...At 5.0 feet, Fast flowing water may erode banks and
approach homes near the river.  Private bridges could drive
localized flooding as debris accumulates along the upstream sides.
Further rises may make bridges unsafe to cross and isolate
residents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 5:00 AM MDT Tuesday the stage was 3.3 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 4.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
this morning to a crest of 5.1 feet this afternoon. It will then
fall below flood stage this evening.
- Flood stage is 5.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 5.1
feet on 05/21/1991.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/abq.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 900 PM MDT.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued September 28 at 9:03PM CDT until October 1 at 11:00AM CDT by NWS Quad Cities IA IL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Iowa...

Wapsipinicon River near De Witt 4S affecting Clinton and Scott
Counties.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Wapsipinicon River near De Witt 4S.

* WHEN...Until Thursday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, Overbank flooding occurs. Water affects
residences along the river between Wheatland and Calamus. Water
affects businesses along the river near Calamus.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM CDT Monday the stage was 12.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
Thursday morning and continue falling to 8.6 feet Tuesday,
October 6th.
- Flood stage is 11.0 feet.
